name: player_hit_callback_record_context_and_timed_status
description: Player::HitCallback_RecordContextAndTimedStatus applies damage callback bookkeeping, status-meter updates, damage feedback, AI alert state, destroyed-state rewards, and captured-hit vehicle impulse behavior.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player combat/source-cluster pass.

The smoke focuses on inactive early return plus the live positive-damage path. The death/reward and AI buddy-alert branches are implemented from BN evidence but are mainly covered through their direct helper smokes until a broader Player combat cluster pass adds end-to-end runtime coverage.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x43b870 shows the inactive-state early return, self-hit owner guard, recent-hit and timed-hit source handling, damage-protection gate, statusMeterValue/statusMeterScaled writes, destroyed-state transition and reward spawning, damage feedback scalar update, AI steering/buddy-alert latch, OptCatalog damage-context update, and captured source-hit direction impulse.

The native smoke checks inactive return and a live hit that reduces status health, updates scaled status and damage feedback, records damage context, applies the captured-hit direction impulse through the root-node matrix, and restores the zMath matrix stack.
